pages.text: Combat stats govern your physical prowess in battle. There are 7 combat stats:$(li)Brute Force - Heavy weapon damage$(li)Blade Technique - Finesse weapon damage$(li)Rapidité - Attack speed and flurry$(li)Agility - Dodge and movement$(li)Physical Resistance - Damage reduction$(li)Physical Endurance - Stamina and regeneration$(li)Precision - Ranged accuracy and damage

At level 100, each combat stat unlocks a powerful active skill:$(li)Heavy Strike (Brute Force)$(li)Blade Dance (Blade Technique)$(li)Blitz Assault (Rapidité)$(li)Shadow Step (Agility)$(li)Stone Skin (Physical Resistance)$(li)Endurance Surge (Physical Endurance)$(li)Precision Shot (Precision)
